name: swt
expr: wH = swt(x, 3, 'haar'); [A2, D2] = swt(x, 2, 'haar'); wdb2 = swt(x, 2, 'db2'); wsgl = swt(single(x),1,'haar'); sglok = double(abs(double(wsgl(2,1)) - wH(1,1)) < 1e-6);
comment: Sig: swc = swt(x, n, wname); [swa, swd] = swt(x, n, wname). 2026-09-18 fix: exact swt.m port (per-extend + conv + wkeep) — detail rows are now SIGN-EXACT (the old fwd-correlation kernel negated every detail row; this spec previously masked it with abs() fingerprints). Also covers the two-output SWA/SWD form (level-2 rows) and db2 non-palindromic filters. Single path closeness predicate (reference computes single end-to-end).
